price_type.title: BizGroupPaymentType
price_type.description:
Payment type for a BizGroup.

- `free`: free (on prod this can only be created by Intree staff)
- `one_time`: one time payment
- `subscription`: subscription

paid_by.title: BizGroupPaidBy
paid_by.description:
Who pays for a BizGroup.

- `business`: Attached card pays for each member.
- `member`: Member of group pays.

In both cases the payment will go to the business where Intree takes a fee.

price.title: Price
price.description: Price in US cents. Should be 0 when `price_type=free`. `price_type=free` should have `paid_by=business`. Min for member paid: 200 cents.

anyOf.title: BizGroupBillingInterval
anyOf.description:
Billing interval for BizGroup subscriptions.

Use interval if and only if `price_type=subscription`.

When `paid_by=business`, then always `interval=month` and `interval_count=1`.

Interval is defined similar to Stripe's interval and interval_count:
- E.g. if `interval=month` and `interval_count=3` then bills occur every 3 months.
- Maximum of three years interval allowed (3 years, 36 months, or 156 weeks).

one_time_duration_minutes.title: One Time Duration Minutes
one_time_duration_minutes.description: Duration in minutes for one-time payment. Does not work for subscriptions. If null, then no limit. If set, then it will limit the duration of the group.

visibility.title: BizGroupVisibility
visibility.description:
Visibility of a BizGroup.

`public`: visible to everyone

`private`: only access through link or invitation, but cannot be seen

`member_public`: visible to members of the community

`group_member_public`: like private but visible to members already in the group

access_state.title: BizGroupAccessState
access_state.description:
Specifies the access state of a BizGroup - how it can be accessed.

- `public`: anyone can join
- `application`: requires application

member_limit.title: Member Limit
member_limit.description: Max number of members allowed in the group. If null, then no limit. If subscription, then it will limit the current number of active members. If one-time payment, then it will limit the number of total joined members.

treet_share_access.title: TreetShareAccess
treet_share_access.description:
The access level of a Treet share for packs.

- `none`: Only members can receive treets from the pack
- `one_level`: Members can share treets from the pack
- `reshares`: Users receiving treets from anyone can share them
